correctness.rationale: Using cosh(t+T/2)cosh(t−T/2)=(cosh2t+cosh T)/2, the ambiguity of f_m=sech^m reduces to a parameter-differentiated Fourier integral. Base transform for m=1 equals π sin(uT)/(sinh T sinh πu), u=πν; the (m−1)-fold D_T=(sinh T)^{−1}∂_T derivative with factorial and 2^m factors gives all m. At T=0 the beta identity 2^{2m−1}|Γ(m+iπν)|²/Γ(2m)>0. For fixed T≠0, high-u leading sine with O(u^{m−2}) error plus derivative control ensures exactly one simple root near each sufficiently high sine zero, N_{m,T}(R)=|T|R+O(1). Under y=πTν, the rescaled operator converges locally uniformly with O(T²) to y^m j_{m−1}(y); Rouché and conjugation yield unique real simple root near every positive Bessel zero with O(T²) displacement and compact-interval root census. For m=2 exact tan y=(tanh T/T)y has one simple positive root in (jπ,jπ+π/2), j≥1. Independently checked m=1..4 high-precision Fourier integral/closed-form comparisons and representative m=2 tangent/Bessel roots; high-frequency/all m remains analytical.
